name: Design
description: Canvas artifact workflows for brands, prototypes, pages, and decks.
examples: Polish this web app screen so it feels less generic
Create a Canvas project and build a clickable landing page artifact
Explore tasteful logo directions as a Canvas artifact
Write and place landing page hero copy in an interactive Canvas prototype
Design a persuasive business slide deck as Canvas presentation artifacts
Turn this investor pitch outline into a validated Canvas deck
Preview this Canvas artifact in Agent Browser and test the interactions
Generate prototype images and use them in a Canvas artifact
Design an on-brand Instagram carousel with generated backdrops and HTML type
Make a birthday card for a teammate in our brand style
long_description: Use the Design plugin to create first-party Canvas artifacts and design-direction workflows. Agents use the built-in canvas CLI to create org-scoped projects, scaffold web_page and presentation artifacts under /workspace/canvas, edit self-contained HTML/CSS/JS, use semantic HTML with data-canvas-id anchors, validate and verify artifacts, preview them with Agent Browser, generate images when prototypes need real visuals, and sync finished artifacts to the control plane.
